description: This source file contains test classes and methods for relational storage using ADO.NET, including streaming data tests, cancellation tests, and database read/write operations within a unit testing framework (Xunit). It defines a data model for streaming tests, a base class for storage tests, and includes methods for inserting and reading binary streams, handling cancellation tokens, and verifying data integrity.

classes.name: StreamingTest
classes.description: Data model used for streaming-related tests, containing an integer ID and a byte array for streamed data.

classes.name: RelationalStoreTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for relational database storage tests using ADO.NET, providing methods to insert, read, and verify streaming data, as well as handle cancellation testing.

methods.name: InsertAndReadStreamsAndCheckMatch
methods.description: Runs parallel tasks to insert binary streams into the database and verifies that read data matches the inserted data.

methods.name: InsertIntoDatabaseUsingStream
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a byte array into the database as a stream associated with a specific ID.

methods.name: ReadFromDatabaseUsingAsyncStream
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a streamed byte array from the database given a stream ID, returning a StreamingTest object with the data.

methods.name: CancellationTokenTest
methods.description: Performs a database read operation with a cancellation token to test if the operation respects cancellation and handles timeouts.
